input.summary: Re-base the cap to the greater of 12 months' Fees and USD 1,000,000, remove "without exception", and extend the payment carve-out to all undisputed amounts due.
input.comment: [Playbook] We have moved the cap to the greater of 12 months' Fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000 and deleted "without exception" so the Excluded Claims in Section 21.3 (confidentiality, data protection and security, indemnities, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement) sit outside the cap. We also extended the payment carve-out to undisputed amounts due under the Agreement, since defined "Fees" omits taxes, expenses and interest.

ops.oldText: 21.1 Each Party's aggregate liability shall not exceed Fees actually paid in the one month preceding the event, without exception.
ops.newText: 21.1 Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's aggregate liability shall not exceed the greater of Fees paid or payable in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000.

ops.oldText: Customer's obligation to pay undisputed Fees for conforming Services is not damages and is not limited by this Section.
ops.newText: Customer's obligations to pay undisputed amounts due under this Agreement are not damages and are not limited by this Section.
